title: packet-mswsp.c: Various code cleanup
description:
1. wmem_packet_scope -> pinfo->pool
2. Replace dynamic arguments in many functions with handling at the layer above because they were rarely needed (usually a constant string) and could be replaced by wmem_strdup_printf at the layer above.
3. Removed many unnecessary forward function declarations
4. Used proto_tree_add_item_ret_uint more liberally

notes.body: @martin.r.mathieson - This looks to have found a bug in check_typed_item_calls.py - If hf_mswsp_msg_ConnectIn_MachineName doesn't have the 2 arguments in its proto_tree_add_item call, the field is displayed incorrectly.
